jsCalibration.policy: Only hosted CI_FILE_TIMING success===true observations raise each actual platform map; failed, partial and local runs never populate these observations. Unmeasured files retain the existing unknown fallback floor.

jsPlanning.model: Per-file maximum of the actual selected platform map (unknown files retain the fallback) and explicit local and cross-platform planning floors. Unknown platforms conservatively use the cross-platform maximum. This is placement only: no execution cache, passing-scope permission or timeout change.
